content: Name Wdg M_ Global Status Type Kind Type Derived from uint8 Range WDGM_ GLOBAL_ STATUS_ OK 0 Supervision did not show any failures. WDGM_ GLOBAL_ STATUS_ FAILED 1 Supervision has failed but is still within the limit of allowed failures. WDGM_ GLOBAL_ STATUS_ EXPIRED 2 Supervision has failed, the allowed limit of failures has been exceeded, but the Watchdog Driver has not yet been instructed to stop triggering. WDGM_ GLOBAL_ STATUS_ STOPPED 3 Supervision has failed, the allowed limit of failures has been exceeded, and the Watchdog Driver has been instructed to stop triggering. A watchdog reset is about to happen. WDGM_ GLOBAL_ STATUS_ DEACTIVATED 4 Wdg M is not initialized and therefore will not manage the watchdogs. Description This type shall be used for variables that represent the global supervision status of the Watchdog Manager module. Variation -- Available via Rte_ Wdg M_ Type.h
